info.description: The Akermani Produce Details Management API allows users to create and manage detailed information about Akermani produce items in the catalog. This API endpoint facilitates the addition of new produce details, ensuring that the catalog remains up-to-date and accurate. Typical consumers include inventory managers and e-commerce platforms looking to optimize their product offerings. Integration with this API enables seamless updates to the produce catalog, enhancing operational efficiency and user experience.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create new details for Akermani Produce. Provide the necessary information in the request body to successfully add the new produce details to the database.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the details for creating or updating produce information related to the Akermani entity. It must be formatted as JSON and should include all necessary fields as defined in the schema.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested details.

isPriority.description: Indicates if the request is a priority order.
